author: KEXP
description: Bangkok-based band Slowwves craft immersive, atmospheric soundscapes steeped in ambient textures and 90s shoegaze. Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival, the band share a performance of "Anywhere Else" and more.
title: Slowwves performs "Anywhere Else" & more Live on KEXP at AXEAN Festival

author: KEXP
description:
http://KEXP.ORG and AXEAN present Live on KEXP in Bali with Slowwves performing at Puri Bhagawan. Recorded August 30, 2026.

Songs:
Labyrinth 00:50
Vortex 04:05
Anywhere Else 07:42
Evangeline 11:42
Killed By Egoistic Disease 18:00

Live on KEXP in Bali is a partnership with AXEAN and Jimbaran Hijau. Recorded at Puri Bhagawan, in Bali, Indonesia.

Iya (Jill) Ngoentaweekoon - Vocal, Guitar
Juckapob (Peem) Lamulpak - Guitar
Pawaris (Jump) Chotnikhom - Drum
Aut Arbsuwan - Bassist

Audio Recording: Matt Ogaz
Guest Audio Engineer: Peemadate Ploysuwan

Audio Mastering: Julian Martlew

Audio Production Assistants: Anggi Artyana, Jesking, Gus Apri, Hari Jaya, Eka Sudida

Cameras: Jim Beckmann, Carlos Cruz, Luke Knecht & Ettie Wahl
Editor: Jim Beckmann

Fixer: Natha Raharja

Lighting Guard: Riyan Grevan
Camera Guard: ⁠Soebandi
